name: Piper Black
source:
Piper Black is an exterminator working under his father, but his childhood was anything but ordinary.

[From [url=https://eggcrepe.itch.io/piper-black]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
派珀．布萊克是一名在父親手下工作的除蟲人員，但他的童年卻一點也不尋常。

（摘自[url=https://eggcrepe.itch.io/piper-black]itch.io[/url]）
